content: Plan 9 auth domain setup (verified 9p.io standalone-cpu-server wiki + authsrv(6) man + Harvey in-tree): components ALL exist in Harvey sys/src/cmd/auth (authsrv.c keyfs.c factotum/ login.c passwd.c changeuser.c, mkfile TARG list) + rc/bin/service.auth/{authsrv.tcp567,authsrv.il566} (rename to enable) + rc/bin/cpurc commented template lines 39-51 (auth/keyfs -wp -m /mnt/keys /adm/keys; auth/cron; aux/listen -q -t /rc/bin/service.auth -d /rc/bin/service tcp). ndb: /lib/ndb/local needs authdom=X auth=<ip> sys=<name> ip=<ip> entry; /lib/ndb/auth needs hostid=<hostowner> uid=* speakfor line; lib/ndb/common already maps tcp=ticket port=567 and tcp=ncpu port=17010. p9sk1 ticket exchange per authsrv(6): CHc -> AuthTreq+IDs+DN+CHs -> tickets(AuthTc/AuthTs)+AuthAc -> AuthAs; AS generates random keys for unknown users to prevent probing. Deps libauth/libauthsrv/libsec/libmp/libndb/libbio all already aarch64-green in Harvey v1.0.
